verdict.rationale: Slack ships an official, documented CLI for creating and managing Slack apps from the command line, including `slack create` for scaffolding Bolt projects from starter templates, and a probe confirms the official CLI docs page. Its documented scope is app development rather than general workspace operations, and nothing ties it specifically to AI-native or agent workflows. Missing for 10: evidence of CLI commands for workspace actions (messaging, search), any AI/agent-oriented CLI usage, independent or hands-on corroboration.
